Name: Nyapu's Portraits (YoungWizard)
Author: MEGA0418
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I'm a big fan of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's portraits[/url], and while looking through his mod files, I saw that he had images for a younger wizard. So I created this mod as a separate add-on to Nyapu's portrait mod, so it doesn't interfere with the original. I'm not sure if it's compatible with other mods, but feel free to configure it however you like.
This is my first attempt at making a mod, so I'd appreciate any recommendations.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download ,unzip and put in your mods folder.
